_notes: three.js conventions: Y up, right-handed, metres, ground plane y=0. Camera at (0,h,0), the plaza recedes along -Z. camera.rotationEuler = [x,y,z] radians, order 'YXZ' (yaw about Y, pitch about X, roll 0); lookAt is an equivalent target. fovVertical in degrees (three.js PerspectiveCamera.fov), derived from a 35 mm lens on 36 mm sensor width (horizontal fov) at 16:9. Proxy box: center, size [x,y,z] full extents, rotationY radians. Cylinder: center (middle), radius, height. plate_02: small plaza, camera at (0,h,0) looking down -Z toward the facade. Scale from the facade door leaf 2.0 m (ground row 380, top row 317 at x 681); the door base is taken as the ground plane. walkable: polygon [x,z] on y=0 from the painted plaza edges (left curb line ~x -5..-8, right curb ~x 5.5..6.5, far edge = pavement edge in front of the facade z about -27.5), clipped to the camera footprint; hole = round planter footprint (square around the cylinder) with 0.35 m margin. planter_lower/planter_upper: cylinders (stone tiers); tree_trunk: cylinder; tree_canopy: box at the trunk depth with a plate mask (foliage, see-through gaps). wall_*: invisible depth-only walls just outside the walkable edge (building fronts). Lamp post painted at the facade (z about -31) is outside the walkable area and has no proxy. Proxy "mask": file in /plates/ (1280x720, white = object); the app discards proxy fragments where the mask is black, in screen space. exit to_stairs (-> plate_03 arrival from_plaza): strip at the far right edge (x 3.4..5.4, z -27.3..-23.5) in front of the second street gap painted between the central facade and the right building row; arrival from_stairs at (2.6,-22). No walkable.surfaces: the whole plaza is y = 0. sun.direction: unit vector from the scene toward the sun (ray to the painted sun disc). Character height later: 1.28 m. Hand-read pixel coordinates are in tools/maps/plate_02.json. exits: [{name, zone: polygon [[x,z],...] on the ground inside the walkable area, to: target map id, arrival: arrival name in the target map}]; the character entering a zone leaves the map. arrivals: [{name, position: [x,z], facingY}] spawn points; facingY radians about Y, model forward +Z (glTF), same convention as markers (0 = faces +Z, toward the camera on a street map; pi = faces -Z). Arrival 'start' is the default spawn. Every arrival is inside the walkable area, outside every exit zone, at least 0.5 m from zones, holes and the walkable edge (checked by build_scene.py).

camera.rollAssumed: 0 (horizon not visibly tilted; plate is only approximately one-point)
